name: actor-20-mdb-procurement-monitor
title: World Bank Procurement + Debarment - Delta JSON Feed
description: Monitors the World Bank's public Procurement Notices API and 'Other Sanctions' debarment table, normalizing records into a consistent 18-field schema with cross-run delta detection (new, status-changed, updated). World Bank only — ADB and IDB were researched and excluded as inaccessible.
